title: Annotatio V §.II Autoritative (Eph. 4): Unto the unity of the faith and the perfect man — truthing in love
pass_a_gloss: until we all arrive at the unity of the faith and of the knowledge of the Son of God, unto a perfect man — until we all come to one faith [namely in all and each] and become a perfect man (v. 13), not to be moved or tossed about by every wind of Doctrine (v. 14), meanwhile ἀληθεύοντες ἐν ἀγάπῃ — studying Truth in Charity (v. 15).
pass_b_english: The aim is that we all arrive at the unity of the faith and the knowledge of the Son of God, unto a full-grown man (v. 13) — not tossed by every wind of teaching (v. 14) —
meanwhile speaking truth in love, studying truth in charity (v. 15).
source_text: quò καταντήσωμεν οἱ πάντες εἰς τὴν ἑνότητα τῆς πίστεως καὶ ἐπιγνώσεως τοῦ ὑιοῦ τοῦ θεοῦ εἰς ἄνδρα τέλειον, donec perveniamus omnes ad unam fidem [puta in omnibus & singulis] & in perfectum virum evadamus v. 13. non dimovendum vel circumagitandum omni ventô Doctrinae v. 14. intereà ἀληθεύοντες ἐν ἀγάπῃ in Charitate Veritati studentes v. 15.
notes: Eph 4:13–15; unity of faith; truthing in love.
